autonomy.notes: manual | supervised | autopilot | full. See tools/policy.mjs. Compliance must pass before anything runs on its own; spend never passes the caps. earned: a type|channel the owner approved unchanged the last streak times (min 5) may run on its own (tools/lib/earned.mjs); price and anything in never_auto never earn it, one rejection resets it, and spend still needs auto_spend_per_day and the caps. Set earned to false to turn it off.

creative.notes: AI image/video generation (tools/creative-gen.mjs). 0 refuses all paid generation; only the owner raises it.

social_inbox.notes: tools/social-inbox.mjs: reads comments and DMs, writes reply drafts for approval only.

voice.notes: tools/connectors/voice.mjs: off by default. Calls need consent, calling hours, caps, a paid budget and an owner approval each; never auto-approved.
